mapper.select: SELECT * FROM schema_common.rule_definition WHERE category = #{category} AND status = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO schema_common.rule_definition (rule_code, rule_name, category, drl_content, params, status, version, created_by) VALUES (#{ruleCode}, #{ruleName}, #{category}, #{drlContent}, CAST(#{params, typeHandler=com.scfs.common.mybatis.JsonMapTypeHandler} AS jsonb), #{status}, #{version}, #{createdBy})

INSERT INTO schema_common.rule_change_log (rule_id, rule_code, change_type, old_version, new_version, old_content, new_content, status, maker_id) VALUES (#{ruleId}, #{ruleCode}, #{changeType}, #{oldVersion}, #{newVersion}, #{oldContent}, #{newContent}, #{status}, #{makerId})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM schema_common.rule_change_log WHERE rule_id = #{ruleId} AND status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM schema_common.rule_change_log WHERE rule_id = #{ruleId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM schema_common.rule_change_log WHERE status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schema_common.rule_change_log WHERE status = 'PENDING'
mapper.update: UPDATE schema_common.rule_change_log SET status = #{status}, checker_id = #{checkerId}, checked_at = NOW(), reject_reason = #{rejectReason}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
